value.answer: Oakville doesn't have an open Costco yet. The first one there is due fall 2027, on Wyecroft Rd near Burloak Dr. For now the closest open ones are Burlington (1225 Brant St) and Mississauga (3180 Laird Rd). Apple Maps shows the Burlington one closed today for Thanksgiving. I didn't find drive times, so which is closest depends on where in Oakville you are.
